3) Exports: For evidence requests, we prefer SFTP or an encrypted S3 presigned URL. Could you send the export instructions and sample via a secure channel?

Also please confirm the exact fields you populate for "actor" (user email vs. internal id) — our auditors require a mapping.

Daniel — thanks, good questions. Answers inline below and attached documents: audit_log_schema.csv (column descriptions) and audit_log_sample.json (sanitized example). Also attached a short export-instructions PDF with secure delivery options.

1) Retention: Yes — Redwood supports route/model-level retention policies. We can configure immutable retention for specific routes (e.g., payments-model inference) for the 2-year window, while keeping default logs at 90 days. We'll include lifecycle policy details in the export instructions.

2) PII handling: By default, logs capture request metadata (request_id, model, timestamp, actor_id) but not full request payloads. We offer optional redaction/hashing at ingestion if you want to keep payload references while removing PII. The sample export shows request_metadata only; payload references are tokenized IDs.

3) Exports: We support encrypted S3 presigned URLs, SFTP with PGP, and temporary SharePoint containers. Attached PDF has the steps to request an export and the available delivery channels. For audit evidence we typically provide a CSV and a JSON export (both available in the attached sample).

Actor mapping: We populate both an internal actor_id and an actor_type (user | service_account) and will include actor_email when available. If you require a stable mapping to your corporate directory, we can ingest a mapping file or accept SAML/SCIM-sourced attributes.

Proposed next step: 15-minute call Tue 2026-03-31 09:00 PT or Wed 2026-04-01 11:00 PT. Which works for you? Aditya will join to cover the security details.

Best,

Marissa Cole

Hi Daniel / Marissa — quick technical confirmations from Security: 

- Immutable retention: We implement a write-once policy for any retention bucket tagged as "immutable" for the configured window; logs cannot be deleted or altered during that window.
- PII: We offer both on-the-fly redaction and hashing; customers can choose. We can also provide a redaction manifest that lists what fields were redacted per export row.
- Export formats: CSV, NDJSON (newline-delimited JSON), and Parquet are available. For large exports we recommend NDJSON or Parquet.

If you'd like, I can prepare a short export that includes a redaction-manifest column so your auditors can see what was redacted. We can deliver via encrypted S3 presigned URL — I'll generate one for the sample if you confirm SFTP is not strictly required.

Thanks,
Aditya
